Title: 2.1.5 Ensure S3 Buckets Prohibit Public Read Access
Description: Bucket cloud-compliance-demo-public-demo has unrestricted public read access enabled via bucket policy.
RemediationAction: Apply S3 Public Access Block at account and bucket level. Remove open principal wildcard (*) from bucket policy.

Title: 5.2 Ensure no security groups allow ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 to port 22
Description: Security group sg-0123456789abcdef0 allows unrestricted inbound SSH traffic (0.0.0.0/0:22).
ISO_27001_2022: A.8.20 (Network Security), A.8.21 (Security of Network Services)
NIST_CSF: PR.AC-5 (Network Integrity & Access Controls), PR.PT-4 (Network Protection)
RemediationAction: Update security group rules to restrict port 22 to specific bastion or VPN CIDR ranges.

Title: 1.5 Ensure MFA is enabled for all IAM users that have a console password
Description: IAM user cloud-compliance-demo-contractor-no-mfa has console credentials without an active MFA token.
NIST_CSF: PR.AC-1 (Identities and Credentials Issued), PR.AC-7 (Users Authenticated)
CIS_AWS_Benchmark: 1.5 (Ensure MFA is enabled for all IAM users with a console password)
RemediationAction: Enforce virtual or hardware MFA via IAM policy (aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent) or migrate to IAM Identity Center.

Title: AWS Config Rule Failed: encrypted-volumes
Description: Resource vol-0123456789abcdef0 is not encrypted with KMS.
RemediationAction: Enable EBS default encryption using AWS KMS. Snapshot volume and restore with encryption enabled.
